# langsmith_organization_permissions (Data Source)

Lists LangSmith **permission definitions** (name, description, access scope) via GET [`/api/v1/orgs/permissions`](https://api.smith.langchain.com/openapi.json). Use this data source to discover valid permission identifiers when configuring roles or reviewing access. OpenAPI type: `PermissionResponse` with `access_scope` enum `organization` or `workspace`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_organization_permissions" "catalog" {}

output "workspace_scoped_permissions" {
  value = [for p in data.langsmith_organization_permissions.catalog.permissions : p.name if p.access_scope == "workspace"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable placeholder (`organization_permissions`).
- `permissions` (Attributes List) Permission rows returned by the API, sorted by `name` for stable Terraform state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `access_scope` (String) `organization` or `workspace` (OpenAPI `AccessScope`).
- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `name` (String) Permission identifier.
